article.title: OpenAI披露Clay案例：客戶研究進入ChatGPT與Codex，模型按任務分工
article.title_en: OpenAI details Clay's customer-research workflows in ChatGPT and Codex
article.summary: OpenAI在11月24日客戶案例中描述Clay如何把潛客研究、資料補全及市場拓展流程帶入ChatGPT與Codex。
article.summary_en: OpenAI's November 24 customer story describes Clay bringing prospect research, enrichment and go-to-market workflows into ChatGPT and Codex.
highlights: Claygent使用模型做研究、資格判斷、資料補全與訊號偵測。
Sol作主要模型，Astra處理較難任務，Luna用於成本敏感工作；未披露獨立銷售成效。
highlights_en: Claygent uses models for research, qualification, enrichment and signal detection.
Sol is primary, Astra handles harder tasks and Luna cost-sensitive work; no independent sales results are supplied.
article.why: 同一客戶背景可跨研究與銷售工作使用後，B2B團隊可決定哪些資料需先補全，以及哪些任務值得配置較高推理成本。
article.why_en: Shared account context helps B2B teams prioritize enrichment and decide which tasks merit more expensive reasoning.
article.next_step: 選一組潛客，把公開研究、資格判斷及銷售簡報分開列成任務，比較各步資料依據與成本，再決定模型分工。
article.next_step_en: Separate public research, qualification and briefing for a lead sample, then compare evidence and cost at each step before choosing model roles.
article.detail: 這是模型供應商發布的客戶案例，日期代表新案例披露，並非整合首次上線。GTM即市場拓展，指把客戶資料轉成接觸及銷售安排的流程。案例說明不同模型與介面的用途，沒有本刊驗證的勝單或收入提升。編輯建議保留每項客戶判斷的來源，並把未來語音演示及其他構想與現有研究功能分開，避免由願景推定已可使用。
article.detail_en: This is a vendor-published customer story, not a dated integration launch. Go-to-market workflows turn account data into outreach and sales activity. Model and interface roles are described without independently verified wins or revenue. Retain evidence behind account judgments and distinguish existing research from prospective voice demonstrations and other future ideas.
